li.label: stirring Enclave broadcast
li.description: That Enclave broadcast spoke of order, strength, and reclaiming civilization. Inspiring words.

li.label: vile Enclave propaganda
li.description: Listening to the Enclave preach purity and extermination over the radio made my skin crawl.

li.label: celestial omen
li.description: A warm radiance washed across the sky. It felt as though Heaven itself was watching over us.

li.label: searing celestial omen
li.description: That blinding heavenly light stung my eyes and set my blood boiling with unease.
